Bryan Engel

FOUNDER · CONSULTANT · BUILDER

I’m Bryan, a retired U.S. Air Force Captain who helps organizations turn complex technology into practical results.

Over more than 20 years, I’ve led high-stakes technology programs across defense, federal healthcare, and enterprise environments. That work taught me to look beyond the demo: the system has to work, the team has to trust it, and the outcome has to matter.

Today, I bring that perspective to AI strategy, agent development, and implementation through Signal Over Noise AI. I’m also co-founder of Noetic Synthesis and an AI/ML Integration Specialist with The Marlin Alliance, supporting Navy mission owners.
